map.由输入扭矩与减速比求输出扭矩 使用指南: Output Torque from Input Torque and Reduction Ratio User Guide
map.输入电机输入扭矩 τ_in、减速比 GR 与传动效率 η，工具按 τ_out=τ: Enter motor input torque tau_in, reduction ratio GR and transmission efficiency eta, and the tool computes output torque as tau_out = tau_in*GR*eta to evaluate whether the load can be driven after reduction, for torque selection of joint modules.
map.输入输入扭矩 τ_in、减速比 GR、效率 η，求输出扭矩。: Enter input torque tau_in, reduction ratio GR and efficiency eta to find output torque.
map.：T_out=1×10×0.9=9 N·m；减速 10 倍增扭并计 10% 损耗: : T_out = 1 x 10 x 0.9 = 9 N*m; a 10x reduction multiplies torque and a 10% loss is applied.
map.：T_out=10 N·m，理想无损耗。: : T_out = 10 N*m, ideal with no losses.
map.由连杆质量、长度与角度求重力扭矩: Gravity torque from link mass, length and angle
map.由 (x,y) 反解关节角 θ₁,θ₂: Solve joint angles theta1, theta2 from (x,y)
map.由末端线速度与臂长求关节角速度: Joint angular velocity from end linear speed and arm length
map.减速换扭矩，T_out=T_in×i×η。: Reduction trades speed for torque: T_out = T_in x i x eta.
map.忽略损耗时功率守恒：T_in·ω_in=T_out·ω_out。: Ignoring losses, power is conserved: T_in*omega_in = T_out*omega_out.
